heads.t: 國民黨金門縣主委交接 陳玉珍交棒楊鎮浯 2026/10/29 中國國民黨金門縣黨部昨（28）日舉行主任委員交接布達典禮，由參選縣長的原任主委陳玉珍交棒給新任主委楊鎮浯，典禮由國民黨副主席兼秘書長李乾龍主持。 李乾龍代表國民黨主席鄭麗文頒發新任主任委員派任書予楊鎮浯，以及中央政策委員會副執行長派任書予陳玉珍。 李乾龍表示，陳玉珍自民國113年8月接任金門縣黨部主委以來，積極推動地方黨務，深入基層、凝聚組織力量。此次因獲黨提名參選金門縣長，考量競選事務繁重，因而辭去縣黨部主委職務。為持續借重陳玉珍熟悉地方事務及黨務運作的經驗，中央將聘任她擔任政策委員會副執行長。…

heads.t: 重啟「養生照護園區」計畫 造福鄉親 2026/10/29 隨著投票日逼近，候選人政見滿天飛；其中，以開闢「第二大同之家」深受矚目，成為市街與網路熱門的議題。 依據金門縣政府統計資料顯示，目前全縣六十五歲以上長者，有二萬七千多人，占全縣人口20%，意即島上居民每五人之中，就有一人年逾六十五歲，象徵金門是一個健康、長壽的島嶼；且縣政府為打造優質安養環境，提供多項敬老福利措施，包括發放「老人慰助金」，以及健保與假牙補助等等。…

heads.t: 光復節這一天，讓孩子記住土地的故事 2026/10/29 有些歷史寫在課本裡，有些歷史卻藏在一頓飯、一句家常話，以及我們每天踏過的土地上。十月二十五日，當光復節再次走進日曆，我想告訴孩子：認識歷史，不只是記住一個日期，更是學會理解上一代走過的路。 「媽媽，光復節是什麼意思？」 面對女兒的提問，我一時沒有急著回答。對孩子而言，節日可能代表放假、出遊，或是能和家人多相處一天；但對經歷過不同年代的台灣人來說，這一天承載的，是一段值得細細認識的歷史。…
heads.en: On that day, the children remember the story of the land. In the books, some history is hidden in a meal, a saying, and the land we tread every day. On October 25th, as Light Easter walks back into the calendar, I want to tell the children that knowing history is not just about remembering a date, but about learning how to understand the path of the last generation. "Mom, what do you mean by halo?" In response to a question from my daughter, I was not in a hurry to answer. For a child, the holiday may mean a holiday, a trip, or an extra day with his family; but for a Taiwanian who went through different times, the day is a history worth knowing.

heads.t: 不講黑白的黑白貓 2026/10/29 現今屏東的勝利新村，經過一番維護修繕及外租給民眾經營商店之後，煥然一新，雖然還可以找到過去遺留下來的舊觀，但經過整體規劃之後的眷村園區與過去的老舊樣貌，已經不可同日而語了。 家住高雄的我，由於與屏東相距不遠，所以會經常偕同家人到勝利新村一遊。 我見證過舊時的眷村，也看到它的逐年發展，如今變身成一個文青新天地，真是令人開心。 那天我們走在眷村的巷道裡，品嚐老屋新店的感覺，突然在一條小巷道裡，見到這兩隻黑白貓，牠們慵懶自得其樂、不管世界發生任何事一概與我無關的姿態，真是讓我既欽羨又嫉妒。…
heads.en: The black and white cat 2026/10/29, the winning new village in the east, after a few maintenance repairs and extra rents to the people to run the store, is new and, although it may be possible to find the old vision that was left behind in the past, it is no longer the same as in the old village after the whole scheme. I am not far from the east, so I travel with my family to the new village of Victory. It is a pleasure for me to witness the old village, and to see its evolution over the years, and to become a new place. That day we were walking in the alleys of the village, eating the old house's new shop, suddenly in one alley, seeing these two black and white cats, they were lazy and they had nothing to do with me, no matter what happens in the world.

heads.t: 志工服務 2026/10/29 這個世界上到處充滿愛，有許多愛是來自幫助他人的志工。 我，在一次社會實踐活動中，加入了志工的行列，這是我人生中第一次參加志工活動。 記得那是我在社區幫忙行動不便的老人處理家務活，當時的我，會主動去關心老人家，用自己的愛心去幫助老人家處理一些家事。雖然說這些家務事，有些挺普通，但對於這些行動不便的老人家來說卻很困難，需要有一個人去幫他。…
heads.en: Volunteer service 2026/10/29 The world is full of love, many of which come from volunteers who help others. I, for the first time in my life, joined the volunteers in a social event. Remember that I was helping an elderly person in a community who was in a difficult position to do household chores, when I started caring about the elderly and helping them with their own love. While some of these household chores are common, they are difficult for the elderly, who are in a difficult position to move, and one person is needed to help him. I don't know.

heads.t: 嘉峪關登眺 2026/10/29 從酒店一早出發，仰望秋天的天空，天高雲淡，秋風徐徐，炎夏的暑熱漸行漸遠。初秋時節，想不到依然藍天白雲，熱威收斂很多。畢竟，炎夏和涼秋是不同的。 下電瓶車，慢慢步行，遊興比諸先前的張掖七彩丹霞未曾稍減，在兩邊都是輕柳帶風的涼意中，身體汗勿需出；遠遠已經窺見黃土夯築的城牆連綿開去，氣勢雄偉，震撼人心。林蔭道上遊客不見擁擠，小攤接連排開。有人與你玩遊戲，城牆下的空地上還有主題歌舞演出。路邊有穿舞服的人員載歌載舞，團友裡的小邱舞細胞興奮起來，也禁不住聞歌起舞。 我們開始登城樓，居高臨下，體驗和感懷這萬里雄關的「前世今生」。…

In the early autumn, the blue sky was still a bit hot. After all, summer and autumn are different. There are dancers on the side of the road in their clothes, and the Qiu cells in their group members are excited and can't stop hearing them. We began to go to the city building, to sit down, to experience and feel the "life of the past." I don't know.

heads.t: 拔河 2026/10/28 輕鬆上陣，雙手緊握粗索，身體後傾往後拉，不料繩索的另一方向，一股蠻力把我拉上前。向前向後，前前後後，不斷拉扯，手掌被粗繩毛邊磨擦，掌心細皮微裂，心神不寧，腳步凌亂……。 這是記憶中年少田徑場上有關拔河的記憶，沒想到多年後我活生生地經歷另一場攸關生命存亡的拔河，衝擊更大。 媽媽往生前，一直與爸爸維持類似候鳥的生活，烈嶼和台灣，兩座島嶼輪流住。但是住台灣時間短，大都是為看醫生而來，老家的恬靜一直是他們想要終老，此情不渝之地。…
heads.en: 2026/10/28 Easier to fight, hands on the coarse cord, back to back, unseemly to the other side of the rope, and a force pulled me forward. Forward, forward, forward, behind and behind, with the palms rubbed by the furs of the rough ropes, the palms twitched, distraught and distraught ... It's the memory of the tug of the Middle Ages, and I didn't expect to experience another life-threatening tug in the years to come. My mother lived like my father's, and my mother lived on two islands. But it's a short time in Taiwan, mostly to see a doctor, and the silence in their home has always been a place where they want to end up. I don't know.

heads.t: 我從林夢帶回一桶番餅 2026/10/22 我從馬來西亞林夢帶回一桶番餅，心裡有說不出的激動。 這種方形馬口鐵打造成餅乾桶（長寬均23.5公分、高26.5公分），桶內裝著Cream Crackers、Osborne 等英式餅乾，是昔日華僑落番返鄉，攜帶回來饋送親友的禮物，我買它，是為滿足一份懷念，是為了想像從前金門落番客為了討生活，告別故鄉，漂洋過海，來到陌生的南洋落腳，後來有機會返鄉探親，成為「番客」，得到一個令人既熟悉又陌生的稱呼。 從前華僑遠從千里回來，攜帶番餅、花布、涼蓆、針線、萬金油等洋貨返鄉，帶回異國他鄉的新奇「細密」件，也帶回他們在外成功的驕傲。…
heads.en: I brought back a barrel of pancakes from the forest, 2026/10/22, and I brought back a barrel of pancakes from the Malaysian dream, with an unspoken excitement. This kind of pony iron creates a biscuit drum (23.5 cm long and 26.5 cm high), which is packed with British cookies such as Cream Crackers and Osborne, returning home with gifts from the past, bringing home relatives and friends, and which I bought in order to fill my heart with the idea of having a guest from the former Golden Gate to spend his life, to leave home, to wander across the sea, to come to the strange South Ocean, and then to have the opportunity to visit his family, to become a “hotman” who is known and strange. They came back thousands of miles from the past and brought home with them seafood, such as pancakes, flowers, cold tea, needles, and gold oil, and also with the strange “secret” items of foreign origin and their pride in their success.

heads.t: 我的特別表弟 2026/10/28 每個人身邊都有特別的人，而我想介紹的，就是我最特別的表弟。 表弟有著帥氣的臉龐和結實的手臂，看起來十分有精神。他每天都跟著爸爸一起搬運貨物，力氣大得驚人。許多我搬不動的東西，他都能輕鬆扛起來，讓我十分佩服。 雖然表弟天生有一些缺陷，說話不像一般人那麼清楚，但他總是帶著燦爛的笑容，活潑又樂觀。我從來沒有看過他因為自己的不足而自怨自艾，反而總是努力學習、認真生活。近年來，他的進步更是讓大家都看在眼裡。原本不太清楚的發音，現在越來越流暢；原本需要別人協助的事情，也漸漸能夠獨立完成。…
heads.en: My special cousin, 2026/10/28, there are special people around, and what I'd like to introduce is my special cousin. A cousin with a handsome face and a strong arm, looks very spiritual. He moved the cargo with his dad every day, and he was so strong. A lot of things I can't move, he can easily carry. I'm impressed. Although his cousin was born with some defects and was not as clear as anyone else, he always had a dirty smile and was lively and optimistic. I've never seen him feel sorry for his fault, but I've always tried to learn and live a life. In recent years, his progress has been more visible to everyone. It's getting better and better, and it's getting better and better to do what needs to be helped. I don't know.

heads.t: 新年新希望 2026/10/28 新年真的很有趣，氣氛熱鬧極了。在這個時刻，我最開心的就是可以放煙火，看著煙火在夜空中綻放，心裡充滿了喜悅。 過年期間，我覺得最棒的事就是全家人聚在一起吃火鍋，有空時去玩夾娃娃機，也是一種特別的樂趣。今年我還學會了玩「甩炮」，只要用力一踩，就會發出清脆的聲響，刺激又好玩。 新的一年，我心裡有個小願望，那就是去很多地方旅遊。我覺得旅遊是一件非常有意思的事，可以看見不一樣的風景、體驗不同的生活。 希望新的一年，每一天都能像過年一樣開開心心！
heads.en: New Year's Hope 2026/10/28 is really fun, and it's so exciting. At this moment, I am most happy to be able to set fire to the night, and to see it in the sky, filled with joy. In the course of the year, I thought the best thing was for the family to get together and have a hot pot and play with dolls when they were free. This year, I learned to play "showers," and once I step on it, it makes a sound that's so sweet and exciting. In the new year, I had a small wish to travel a lot. I think it's a very interesting thing to travel, to see different landscapes and experience different lives. Let's hope we're happy every day like New Year!

heads.t: 記憶中的滋味 2026/10/27 橘紅色的醬料淋在白裡透紅的肉圓裡，柔軟的麵皮包裹著細膩的肉餡。送入嘴裡細細咀嚼，微甜中帶著鹹的滋味，混合著愛意在口中擴散開。 仔細品味著口中的幸福，我不禁回想起從前。 從很久以前，高雄的阿嬤就獨自經營著一間肉圓店。因為爺爺的早逝，留下五個孩子。五個小搗蛋鬼的日常開銷，全都來自那間破舊的小店鋪。…
heads.en: 2026/10/27, the smell of orange red sauce in the white through the red circle of flesh, the soft skin wrapped around the greasy meatloaf. It's a little bit of chewing in its mouth, and it's a little sweet, and it's mixed with love intended to spread out. I can't help but remember what happened. A long time ago, Ko Hung's grandmother ran a meat shop alone. Because of Grandpa's premature death, he left five children behind. The daily expenses of the five little pricks all came from that old shop. I don't know.

heads.t: 校園最美的風景 2026/10/27 校園的美，往往在不經意間出現在我們身邊。它可能是清晨的第一縷陽光；操場上矯健的身影；亦或是放學路上，一腳踩扁的脆葉。 然而窗外那抹最吸睛的翠綠，誠然是我心中最美的風景。它在風中搖曳，迎著風唱著春天的歌，那迎風而生的碧綠，排解了我心中的煩悶，使我豁然開朗。 我原不曾注意過窗前那株樹。它長得不高，枝幹也不挺拔，在眾多蓊鬱的樹木間，顯得格外瘦小。直到某個暮春的傍晚，我推開窗，見它披著一身新綠，在斜陽裡輕輕搖曳，竟顯出幾分動人的姿態來。…
heads.en: The most beautiful view of the campus, 2026/10/27, tends to show up by our side. It may be the first sun in the morning; it may be a robust figure on the playground; or it may be a brittle leaf on the way to school. Yet the greenest of the breath is the most beautiful view in my heart. And it swayeth in the wind, and singeth in the wind the song of spring, the green, which is born of the wind, and He removeth from us the distress of our hearts, and leaveth me open. I never noticed the tree in front of the window. And it is not tall, nor do its branches grow, and it is so thin in the trees, Until some evening of dawn, when We pushed out the window and saw it in a new green, and moved in the sun, and made a few moving gestures.

heads.t: 《美好金門》未來的未來 2026/10/06 民國100年我以共同計畫主持人角色，參與由 AECOM 承辦的《金門縣概念性總體規劃》，且協力負責交通與觀光專題，因此有機會仔細審視「金廈連結」的規劃理念是否經得起考驗。 跨境交通真正需要有效移動的是人，而不是車。 當年我邀請旅美交通專家楊成欽博士參與金門總體規劃。楊博士提出的軌道交通構想，不只是一條軌道，而是一套多元交通串聯的理念；尤其強調跨界交通必須與島嶼內部交通、土地使用及未來發展有機結合。 如果以跨界軌道及公共運輸作為骨幹，把水頭碼頭、金門機場與未來可能形成的跨境節點串聯起來，改變的就不只是交通方式，而有機會重塑金門整體空間的發展格局。…
heads.en: The future of Good Golden Gate 2026/10/06, in which I have been a co-producer for 100 years, participated in the AECOM Conceptual General Plan for Golden Gate County, and worked together on the topic of transport and tourism, thus providing an opportunity to examine whether the concept of "Golden House Link" is acceptable. It is people, not cars, that really need to move effectively across borders. In the same year, I invited Dr. Yang Sung-chun, a travel expert in the United States, to participate in the general planning of the Golden Gate. Dr. Yang's idea of a rail transport structure is not just a track, but a concept of a multifaceted traffic chain; it is particularly important that cross-border traffic be linked to intra-island transport, land use and future development. If cross-border orbits and public transport are used as a backbone, linking the water dock, the Golden Gate airport, and the possible future cross-border nodes change not only the mode of transport, but also the opportunity to reshape the entire gold gate. I don't know.
